Oh, how you shined!
To everyone who raised a light or lit up a landmark to celebrate Voyager’s Light-Day, thank you for shining bright with us.

LIVE: Tune in for an update on our historic Voyager mission, the science the probes are gathering, and the challenges of keeping them working from so far away for so long.
Plus: a Q&A session and a sneak peek at our upcoming Voyager documentary.

node.content-desc: Voyager 1 Light-Day Mission Update and Conversation
